description: This file defines the CreateRelationshipParams class, which is used to handle and validate parameters related to creating relationships between entities in the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for retrieving specific parameters and configuring validation and normalization rules.

classes.name: CreateRelationshipParams
classes.description: A class extending BaseParam that handles parameters required for creating entity relationships, with configuration for validation and normalization.

methods.name: getModuleName
methods.description: Returns the name of the module involved in the relationship.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier related to the relationship.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns an instance of GetRelationshipDataParams containing detailed relationship data.

methods.name: configureParameters
methods.description: Sets up validation rules and default values for parameters using OptionsResolver.
